title: Fed Signals Rate Pause, Silver Jumps 3%
content: The Federal Reserve held its benchmark rate steady on Wednesday and signaled it is likely done raising rates for this cycle, citing cooling inflation data. Silver futures on COMEX jumped 3% within an hour of the announcement as traders priced in lower real yields and a weaker dollar, both of which typically support precious metals. Gold also rose but by a smaller 1.8%, widening the gold-silver ratio's recent narrowing trend. Analysts said the move reflects renewed institutional interest in silver as a monetary hedge heading into the second half of the year.
